name: Naoi Sakura
source:
A girl with a selfish personality.
The silent fart she let out during an entrance exam smelt so bad that she was put on a company blacklist. She joined Asterisk to pay back her parents' leftover debt and to get revenge on society.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01039895.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
